notes.subject: עמס
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'load/carries burden' — translators split between 'loads us with benefits' (KJV) and 'bears our burden' (JPS/ASV); the Hebrew verb is literally 'load a burden on'

notes.subject: סלה
notes.rationale: Musical pause mark, rendered as 'Selah' untranslated

notes.subject: יום יום
notes.rationale: 'day by day' — Hebrew repetition of 'day' doubled for emphasis

translation: Blessed bilong Adonai, de bilong de em i putim piksa long olgeta samting i heavy long yumi, HaEl bilong salvation bilong yumi. Selah.

tokens.gloss: em i putim piksa long olgeta samting i heavy
